fact: Allegedly leaving the pit lane while facing a technical issue with the car.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 12.2.1 h) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video, team radio and in-car video evidence and determined that Car 43 faced a technical issue with the car while in the fast lane of Q1. The team and driver attempted to resolve the issue but failed to do so after a few attempts. The driver then pulled over to the right hand side of the pit exit road, after crossing the pit exit line and exited the car. We did not consider that any rule or regulation had been infringed by the conduct of the team or driver in attempting to resolve the technical issue, notwithstanding the fact that they ultimately failed to do so. We accordingly took no further action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 43 Allegedly Leaving The Pit Lane With A Technical Issue
to: The Team Manager, BWT Alpine Formula 1 Team
